excerpt: Modelflare Build beyond one model. Keep your product moving. Modelflare is an OpenAI-compatible AI API gateway. One API key connects products and agents to GPT, Claude, Gemini, and leading image and video models, with provider routing, ordered fallback, and per-request usage and cost. - One OpenAI-compatible layer for LLM, image, and video models - Provider routing with ordered fallback routes - Request-level usage and cost visibility From model access to reliable delivery. - More models. One place to connect. Compare models, capabilities, and prices across providers. Choose what fits each part of your product. - A backup route, built into your requests. When an upstream failure allows failover, try another eligible route for the same model. Configure a primary route and ordered backups for a regular API key. - One key. Your routing preference. Use the same key across models. Modelflare selects a route for the requested model from those available to your account, following your chosen strategy. Quick start API base URLs - OpenAI: - Anthropic: - Gemini: curl \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $MODELFLARE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"model": "MODEL_ID", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]}' Enterprise & teams Approved enterprise accounts get a console of their own: invite your team, give each member a budget, and see every top-up, request and creation in one place. - Members and budgets Invite admins and members by email, and give each an unlimited, one-time or monthly budget. - Keys with your prefix Enterprise keys start with your own short name, such as acme-, and every request is attributed to the member who made it. - Top-ups and alerts The owner and admins can top up. Alerts email you before the balance or a budget runs out. - Usage, creations and audit See spending by member, model and key, keep the images and videos members create, and review every admin action.
